negative_twin.control_design: Seeded unbacked atom perturbation (inject claim edits with no validated bundle behind them) plus predecessor-label shuffle (reassign bundles to wrong jobs).
negative_twin.expected_signature: Every seeded perturbation is rejected with a recorded reason; label-shuffled bundles produce zero accepted changes (accepting under wrong provenance is a harness defect).

noncompute_resolution.resolution: This job emits no compute reports; under V3_EXECUTOR_BUNDLE_V1 its outputs are the claim-level reconciliation records: CLAIM_DELTA.json plus a paper-sync receipt enumerating every proposed atomic claim change, each gated on a validated predecessor result bundle (RAW_MANIFEST + RESULT_BINDING_PACKET of the producing job). FRONTIER_DOMINANCE_REPORT/RESIDUAL_FAMILY_REPORT are consumed read-only from validated predecessor bundles, never synthesized here. Independent check is an independent claim audit, satisfying required_one_of.

jobs.parent_binding_note: Claim-admission bookkeeping; no classical parent source is an input.

theorem_binding.identification_role: A synchronized manuscript is a conservative successor: preserving every previously earned outside-closure witness, it only strictly expands the claimed family (FD-T2); no internal computation grants paper authority (FD-T7), so the sync itself carries authority delta NONE.

jobs.acquisition_gate: The final residual family, its producing bundles and the refreshed search snapshot are sha256-frozen before adjudication; the reviewer receives the frozen snapshot, not live editable state.
jobs.custody_gate: External authority custody (GAP-EXTERNAL-NOVELTY): the independent reviewer is assigned before outcomes are shared; adjudication receipts are escrowed with reviewer identity and search-window chronology.

donor_first_comparison.donor_product: Refreshed external literature/search baseline: the nearest-work absorption family refreshed at review time, executed against the final residual family.
donor_first_comparison.first_refusal_rule: FD-T5: the residual is submitted to external review only after the refreshed absorption family has had first refusal on it.
donor_first_comparison.matched_resources: Same residual family bytes, same search-tool access window, same adjudication rubric as the candidate side.

negative_twin.control_design: Hostile absorption injection (an adversarially constructed nearest-work claim engineered to look like it absorbs the residual) plus reviewer-identity blinding on the origin of the residual.
negative_twin.expected_signature: The injected claim is correctly classified (absorbed-by-injection or not) with reasons; blinding must prevent origin-tracking bias. Misclassification of the injection or origin-tracking scores is a harness defect.

jobs.parent_binding_note: External novelty adjudication has no classical parent source; the reviewer is external authority.

prospective_execution_contract.outcome_access_denial: Reviewer assigned before outcomes shared; frozen snapshot only, no live editable state.

registered_alternatives.statement: An independent reviewer with a refreshed nearest-work search confirms the residual family survives absorption (backlog terminal EXTERNAL_RESIDUAL_NOVELTY_SUPPORTED).
The refreshed nearest-work search absorbs the residual family, so no external novelty remains.

theorem_binding.identification_role: The reviewer adjudicates the final residual family after donor-first refusal has been executed (FD-T5), with no internal computation able to substitute for external novelty authority (FD-T7); the review scope is exactly the inclusion-minimal residual family, where adding donors cannot increase minimal residuals (RN-T1) and multiple minimal families require an explicit target criterion (RN-T5).
